card.title: Galaxy A125(Mediatek) No Graphics

claims.statement: A Galaxy A125 that boots, vibrates and charges but shows nothing even with a torch can be missing a PMIC graphics supply because pad A17 under the PMIC has torn after drops.
Check the diode value on the relevant pin first; OL or high indicates the fault, then lift the PMIC and jumper pad A17 to the nearest component on that net.

procedure: Diode-test the graphics supply pin (high/OL = suspect).
Lift the PMIC and check pad A17.
Run a jumper from A17 to the nearest component on the same net and verify continuity.
UV-mask, reball and refit the PMIC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
